name: Go! Go! Loser Ranger!
description: With their old hideout and bosses wiped out, the surviving Dusters make a secret agreement with the Ranger Force to engage in the weekly Sunday Showdown - one where they will always be defeated. Tired of this charade, Fighter D finally steps up to make a change once and for all!

videos.title: We Are Justice! The Dragon Keepers!
videos.overview: Tired of the Sunday Showdown charade, Fighter D decides to defeat the Rangers for real this time.

videos.title: Go! Fighter D!
videos.overview: Fighter D reunites with Yumeko Suzukiri, who approaches him with an unexpected proposal.

videos.title: Our Evil Will Bloom, Someday.
videos.overview: Fighter D decides to infiltrate the Red Garrison with Yumeko, only to find himself in a tight spot.

videos.title: The Soldier with Love, Hibiki!
videos.overview: In pursuit of Fighter D, Aran Hekiru, a Blue Junior Third Rank, discovers his connection to Hibiki.

videos.title: Fighter D, as a Part of “Ranger Force”
videos.overview: Fighter D infiltrates the White Dragon's Nest in disguise and discovers someone in hiding.

videos.title: 1 Plus 2 Equals... Threat!
videos.overview: Fighter D and Kai Shion work together to face off against Shun Tokita in the final exam.

videos.title: The Zigzag Road to the Final Exam!
videos.overview: Fighter D's plans go awry as Shion works with the other cadets on the second day of the exam.

videos.title: Shout Out Loud, Cadets!
videos.overview: Peltrola sneaks into the White Dragon's Nest, and meets Komachi Aizome of the Blue Squadron.

videos.title: Battle! Fever! Fighter D!
videos.overview: Fighter XX steps in to help Fighter D but is stopped by Blue Keeper with his Divine Artifact.

videos.title: It's Showtime for Blue Keeper!
videos.overview: Peltrola retreats after an all-out fight with Blue Keeper, but is halted by the Junior First Ranks.

videos.title: On the Road to My Justice!
videos.overview: The cadets, Junior First Ranks, and Blue Keeper team up against Peltrola and their clones.

videos.title: Never Stop, Fighter D!
videos.overview: Fighter D engages in a head-to-head fight with Blue Keeper despite his overwhelming disadvantage.

videos.title: Look! The Dragon Keepers!
videos.overview: Fighter D encounters Chidori, a peculiar man investigating a string of mysterious disappearances.

videos.title: For This School, in This Moment
videos.overview: Fighter D and his squadmates encounter an enigmatic organization and are trapped in an illusion.

videos.title: Lost Memories
videos.overview: Fighter D and Hisui prepare for combat as the Green Squadron reunites with someone unexpected.

videos.title: Make Our Dreams Come True, Ranger Force
videos.overview: Fighter D turns the tide of the battle searching for a way back into the illusory school.

videos.title: The Arrival of Green ~The Maji Tsuyo Force~
videos.overview: Fighter D continues his search for the boss monster Magatia with Hisui and Nishiki, a detective.

videos.title: Lost in Confusion...Seriously
videos.overview: Fighter D begins executing his plan to take down the Green Keeper with Suzukiri's help.

videos.title: We Are the Monster Protection Society
videos.overview: While the Ranger Force's deception is revealed, a new organization begins to lurk behind the scenes.

videos.title: Come and Join the Monsters!
videos.overview: Fighter D and Hisui confront Yakushi Usukubo, the Head Director of the Monster Protection Society.

videos.title: Here Comes Fighter D!
videos.overview: Fighter D learns the shocking truth behind the Divine Artifacts, Dragon Keepers, and monsters.

videos.title: A Special Bond ~Hibiki and Sesera~
videos.overview: The thread of fate connecting Hibiki and Sesera begins unraveling towards an unexpected outcome.

videos.title: The Dragon Keepers vs. Deathmecia
videos.overview: As the world is under attack by the Monster Army, Fighter D renews his resolve once again.

videos.title: The One and Only Fighter D
videos.overview: Fighter D decides to cooperate with the Ranger Force temporarily to corner Deathmecia.
